notes.title: Update Notes for 11/10/2023
notes.content:
- Analog stick now supported in main menu.
- Game now pauses automatically if gamepad is disconnected.
- Minor graphical tweaks have been implemented.
- 64-bit processor and operating system are now required.

notes.title: DualShock 4 and DualSense gamepads are now supported in Ultra Mission™!
notes.content:
Expanded Gamepad Support

There has never been a better time to blast than right now! Ultra Mission™ has been updated to better support various gamepads, including Sony's DualShock 4 and DualSense controllers.

The following gamepads are now supported by the Steam version of Ultra Mission™:


Xbox One Controller
Xbox Series X|S Controller
Other XInput Gamepads
DualSense
DualShock 4*

*Does not support vibration
